correctness.rationale: Strict positive Hessians of trace(A^-1) and trace(A^-2) on connected weighted Laplacians establish unrestricted unique optima. The cycle/two-layer eigenvalues prove exact scalar moment and root formulas; the strictly decreasing R_p gives one positive root. Rational signs at m=3,5,6, exact symmetry at m=4 and a proven lower barrier for all m>=7 give the complete reversal. The exact Poisson-kernel cycle resolvent and uniform asymptotic bracketing prove the two exponents, minimum and regret. Decoded standalone verify.py passed 475 checks. Computations are supplemental, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Two standard physically motivated coherence objectives demand different network design scales (rung/rail ~m^-2/3 versus m^-6/5), and their exact preference reverses at the first nontrivial five-rung boundary. An unrestricted globally unique optimizer, exact finite-size equation and quantified objective regret make this a meaningful all-size structural optimal-design result, not a routine fixed-parameter evaluation. The absolute regret grows while relative regret vanishes, as explicitly proved.
